bio.text: José M. Serrano is a member of the New York State Senate representing District 29, a seat he has held since 2013 after serving District 28 from 2005, according to Ballotpedia.
He is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot as the Democratic and Working Families Party candidate for re-election.
Ballotpedia lists his earlier experience as a member of Community Board 4 and of the New York City Council, District 17.
Ballotpedia says he earned a B.A. in government from Manhattan College.
